description: The widest front on the street and the only one with its boards still true: a proper mercantile, false front squared and lettered THE DRY GOODS in white, with a boardwalk out front swept every morning whether it needs it or not. Barrels stand either side of the door under a canvas awning gone the colour of weak tea. Nothing in the window is a luxury. Everything in the window is something you would be sorry to be without.
name: The Dry Goods
